title: Getting Started with External Data
author: Developer
content: This post was loaded from an external JSON file. The CMS automatically fetches this data when no existing posts are found in localStorage.

title: Why Use External Data?
author: Content Team
content: External data files make it easy to pre-populate your CMS with content. You can maintain your content in a separate file and version it alongside your code.

title: Tips for JSON Data
author: Admin
content: Make sure each post has a unique 'id', a 'title', 'content', and a valid 'createdAt' timestamp in ISO format. The CMS validates these fields during import.

title: Import vs. External Loading
author: User
content: The external file loads only on first visit (when localStorage is empty). After that, your edits are saved locally. Use the Import button to merge additional data anytime.

title: Customizing Your Content
author: Editor
content: Feel free to edit this JSON file to add your own posts. Add more objects to the array, and the CMS will load them all on first run.
